scientific_authority: Descriptive feasibility diagnostic only; no gate change or training authorization.
purpose: Rough coverage check for the existing fixed uniform/random pool, not a test of a learned set scorer or the proposed learned-static plus perturbation pool.
excluded_reason: These recorded teacher-derived controls require expensive policy queries to construct; they are comparison references, not deployable pool candidates.
budget_semantics: Each final budget is analyzed independently. Uniform/random sets were constructed from the full token grid; random construction includes budget in its seed. They are not a validated nested stage candidate tree or an implemented staged method.
oracle_definition: For each observation and each final budget separately, min of its four recorded candidate E values. No best seed is selected globally across observations.
containment_warning: The pool includes uniform, so oracle E <= uniform E is guaranteed by construction. This is not evidence of learnability, closed-loop success, or deployable oracle selection.
E_definition: FP32 mean absolute error over8x7 normalized actions against the same-observation full512 teacher reference. Values are read from per-observation exact results, not an aggregate summary.
aggregation: Arithmetic mean across observations. Overall12-observation means equal4 episode means because each episode contributes3 stages. Candidate count and stages are not independent replication. No confidence intervals or significance claims.

tie_policy.oracle_value: Exact minimum of recorded unrounded FP32-derived E values; no tolerance-based replacement of the minimum.
tie_policy.all_winners: Record all candidates with E exactly equal to the minimum.
tie_policy.counts: Report deterministic first-in-order winner and equal fractional credit to all exact winners. Exact comparisons also determine reference/oracle wins.
